217	    def create_video_prompt_type(self, mask_video_path: Optional[Path], guide_video_path: Optional[Path] = None) -> str:
218	        """
219	        Create video_prompt_type string for VACE compatibility.
220	
221	        Args:
222	            mask_video_path: Path to mask video, if created
223	            guide_video_path: Path to guide video, if created
224	
225	        Returns:
226	            video_prompt_type string (e.g., "VM", "VIM", "UM")
227	        """
228	        ctx = self.ctx
229	
230	        travel_guidance_config = self._get_travel_guidance_config()
231	        path_taken = "default"
232	        video_prompt_type_str = ""
233	        raw_guide_used = False
234	
235	        if travel_guidance_config is not None:
236	            if travel_guidance_config.is_ltx_anchor:
237	                video_prompt_type_str = "KFI"
238	                path_taken = "travel_guidance:ltx_anchor"
239	            elif travel_guidance_config.is_ltx_hybrid:
240	                parts = []
241	                if travel_guidance_config.has_control:
242	                    mode_map = {
243	                        "video": "VG",
244	                        "pose": "PVG",
245	                        "depth": "DVG",
246	                        "canny": "EVG",
247	                    }
248	                    parts.append(mode_map.get(travel_guidance_config.mode, ""))
249	                if travel_guidance_config.has_anchors:
250	                    parts.append("KFI")
251	                video_prompt_type_str = "".join(parts)
252	                path_taken = "travel_guidance:ltx_hybrid"
253	            elif travel_guidance_config.is_ltx_control:
254	                video_prompt_type_str = "VG"
255	                path_taken = "travel_guidance:ltx_control"
256	            elif travel_guidance_config.kind == "uni3c":
257	                # Uni3C needs VG for LTX-2, but VACE must still suppress the
258	                # raw video guide to avoid double-feeding motion guidance.
259	                video_prompt_type_str = "VG" if self._is_ltx2_model() else ""
260	                path_taken = "travel_guidance:uni3c"
261	            elif travel_guidance_config.kind == "none":
262	                video_prompt_type_str = ""
263	            else:
264	                video_prompt_type_str = ""
265	
266	            if video_prompt_type_str:
267	                travel_logger.debug_block(
268	                    "GUIDE",
269	                    {
270	                        "segment": ctx.segment_idx,
271	                        "model": ctx.model_name,
272	                        "path": path_taken,
273	                        "is_vace": self.is_vace_model,
274	                        "guide": bool(guide_video_path),
275	                        "mask": bool(mask_video_path),
276	                        "video_prompt_type": video_prompt_type_str,
277	                    },
278	                    task_id=ctx.task_id,
279	                )
280	                return video_prompt_type_str
281	
282	        if self.is_vace_model:
283	            path_taken = "vace"
284	            vpt_components = []
285	
286	            # Check if uni3c is handling motion guidance - if so, skip VACE video guide
287	            # Use config if available, fallback to legacy detection
288	            is_uni3c_mode = self._structure_config.is_uni3c
289	            if not is_uni3c_mode:
290	                # Non-uni3c: use VACE video guide as normal
291	                vpt_components.append("V")
292	                raw_guide_used = True
293	
294	            # Add mask component if mask video exists
295	            if mask_video_path:
296	                vpt_components.append("M")
297	
298	            video_prompt_type_str = "".join(vpt_components)
299	        elif self._is_ltx2_model():
300	            path_taken = "ltx2"
301	            # LTX-2 supports TSEV: T=text, S=start image, E=end image, V=video guide
302	            # Use guide_preprocessing from orchestrator if a guide video is provided
303	            if mask_video_path:
304	                # LTX-2 supports mask preprocessing (A, NA, XA, XNA)
305	                video_prompt_type_str = "VG" + "M" if mask_video_path else "VG"
306	            elif guide_video_path:
307	                # Guide video exists but no mask — use VG for video-guided generation
308	                video_prompt_type_str = "VG"
309	            else:
310	                # No guide video — use start image mode for keyframe-based generation
311	                video_prompt_type_str = "S"
312	
313	            # Allow orchestrator to override via explicit guide_preprocessing
314	            guide_preprocessing = ctx.orchestrator_details.get("guide_preprocessing")
315	            if guide_preprocessing and travel_guidance_config is None:
316	                video_prompt_type_str = guide_preprocessing
317	                path_taken = "ltx2:explicit_guide_preprocessing"
318	        else:
319	            path_taken = "non_vace"
320	            # Fallback for non-VACE models: use 'U' for unprocessed RGB to provide direct pixel-level control.
321	            u_component = "U"
322	            m_component = "M" if mask_video_path else ""
323	
324	            video_prompt_type_str = u_component + m_component
325	
326	        travel_logger.debug_block(
327	            "GUIDE",
328	            {
329	                "segment": ctx.segment_idx,
330	                "model": ctx.model_name,
331	                "path": path_taken,
332	                "is_vace": self.is_vace_model,
333	                "guide": bool(guide_video_path),
334	                "mask": bool(mask_video_path),
335	                "raw_guide_used": raw_guide_used,
336	                "video_prompt_type": video_prompt_type_str,
337	            },
338	            task_id=ctx.task_id,
339	        )
340	
341	        return video_prompt_type_str
342	
343	    def process_segment(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
344	        """Main processing method that orchestrates all segment operations."""
345	        ctx = self.ctx

349	
350	        # Create mask video

353	        # Create video_prompt_type

355	        hybrid_anchor_payload = self._build_hybrid_anchor_payload()
356	        hybrid_audio_payload = self._build_hybrid_audio_payload()
357	        travel_guidance_config = self._get_travel_guidance_config()
358	
359	        guide_frames = None
360	        guide_frame_status = "none"
361	        if guide_video_path:
362	            try:
363	                guide_frames, _ = get_video_frame_count_and_fps(str(guide_video_path))
364	                guide_frame_status = str(guide_frames)
365	            except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as e:
366	                guide_frame_status = f"error:{type(e).__name__}"
367	
368	        mask_frames = None
369	        mask_frame_status = "none"
370	        if mask_video_path:
371	            try:
372	                mask_frames, _ = get_video_frame_count_and_fps(str(mask_video_path))
373	                mask_frame_status = str(mask_frames)
374	            except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as e:
375	                mask_frame_status = f"error:{type(e).__name__}"
376	
377	        travel_logger.debug_block(
378	            "PARAMS",
379	            {
380	                "segment": ctx.segment_idx,
381	                "target_frames": ctx.total_frames_for_segment,
382	                "valid_4n1": (ctx.total_frames_for_segment - 1) % 4 == 0,
383	                "guide_frames": guide_frame_status,
384	                "mask_frames": mask_frame_status,
385	            },
386	            task_id=ctx.task_id,
387	        )
388	
389	        # Warn if any mismatch detected
390	        if guide_frames and guide_frames != ctx.total_frames_for_segment:
391	            travel_logger.warning(f"[FRAME_COUNTS] Guide frames ({guide_frames}) != target ({ctx.total_frames_for_segment})", task_id=ctx.task_id)
392	        if mask_frames and mask_frames != ctx.total_frames_for_segment:
393	            travel_logger.warning(f"[FRAME_COUNTS] Mask frames ({mask_frames}) != target ({ctx.total_frames_for_segment})", task_id=ctx.task_id)
394	
395	        return {
396	            "video_guide": str(guide_video_path) if guide_video_path else None,
397	            "video_mask": str(mask_video_path) if mask_video_path else None,
398	            "video_prompt_type": video_prompt_type,
399	            "structure_type": self._detected_structure_type,  # Pass through for uni3c handling
400	            "image_refs_paths": hybrid_anchor_payload["image_refs_paths"],
401	            "frames_positions": hybrid_anchor_payload["frames_positions"],
402	            "image_refs_strengths": hybrid_anchor_payload["image_refs_strengths"],
403	            "audio_guide": hybrid_audio_payload["audio_guide"],
404	            "audio_prompt_type": hybrid_audio_payload["audio_prompt_type"],
405	            "audio_scale": hybrid_audio_payload["audio_scale"],
406	            "denoising_strength": (
407	                travel_guidance_config.control_strength
408	                if travel_guidance_config is not None
409	                and travel_guidance_config.is_ltx_hybrid
410	                and travel_guidance_config.has_control
411	                else None
412	            ),
413	        }
414	
415	    def _detect_single_image_journey(self) -> bool:
416	        """
417	        Detect if this is a single image journey (I2V mode, no end anchor).
418	
419	        A single image journey is when:
420	        - Only one input image is provided for this segment
421	        - Not continuing from a video
422	        - AND EITHER:
423	          - This segment is both first and last (entire project is single image)
424	          - OR this is a trailing segment (is_last_segment=True, has no end target)
425	
426	        Returns:
427	            True if this is a single image journey (use I2V mode), False otherwise
428	        """
429	        ctx = self.ctx
430	
431	        input_images_for_check = ctx.orchestrator_details.get("input_image_paths_resolved", [])
432	        is_first_segment = ctx.segment_params.get("is_first_segment", False)
433	        is_last_segment = ctx.segment_params.get("is_last_segment", False)
434	        has_continue_video = ctx.orchestrator_details.get("continue_from_video_resolved_path") is not None
435	
436	        # Single image journey detection:
437	        # 1. Must have exactly 1 input image
438	        # 2. Must not be continuing from a video
439	        # 3. Either: (a) entire project is one segment, OR (b) this is a trailing segment
440	        is_single_image_journey = (
441	            len(input_images_for_check) == 1
442	            and not has_continue_video
443	            and (
444	                (is_first_segment and is_last_segment)  # Single image project
445	                or is_last_segment  # Trailing segment (no end target image)
446	            )
447	        )
448	
449	        return is_single_image_journey
450

33	) -> Optional[Path]:
34	    """Build a segment-local composite guidance clip when no shared clip is provided."""
35	    ctx = proc.ctx

46	        )
47	        frame_overlap_expanded = ctx.orchestrator_details.get("frame_overlap_expanded", [0])
48	        segment_start, _segment_frame_count = calculate_segment_stitched_position(
49	            ctx.segment_idx,
50	            segment_frames_expanded,
51	            frame_overlap_expanded,

53	    segment_end = segment_start + ctx.total_frames_for_segment
54	
55	    local_configs = []
56	    for video in travel_guidance_config.videos:
57	        video_start = video.start_frame
58	        video_end = segment_end if video.end_frame is None else video.end_frame
59	        overlap_start = max(video_start, segment_start)

61	        if overlap_start >= overlap_end:

63	
64	        local_config = video.to_dict()

38	def _derive_model_family(model_name: str | None) -> str:
39	    """Resolve the travel model family from the configured model name.
40	
41	    Model-specific conventions:
42	    - LTX-only: direct `guidance_scale`, `prefix_video_source` continuation,
43	      8-frame quantization, 24fps native output.
44	    - Wan-only: `phase_config`, SVI continuation, 4-frame quantization,
45	      16fps native output, `svi2pro`.
46	    - Shared: `num_frames`, `seed`, `model_name`, `parsed_resolution_wh`,
47	      prompts, LoRAs, and `travel_guidance`.
48	    """
49	    return "ltx" if "ltx" in (model_name or "").lower() else "wan"
50	
51	
52	def _get_model_fps(model_name: str | None) -> int:
53	    """Get the native FPS for a model (e.g. 16 for Wan, 24 for LTX-2).
54	
55	    Queries WGP's model definition when available, otherwise falls back by model family.
56	    """
57	    if not model_name:
58	        return 24
59	    try:
60	        return get_model_fps(model_name)
61	    except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError):
62	        return 24 if _derive_model_family(model_name) == "ltx" else 16

66	    """Get the frame quantization step for a model (e.g. 4 for Wan, 8 for LTX-2).
67

79	def _quantize_frames(frames: int, step: int) -> int:
80	    """Quantize a frame count down to the nearest valid step*N+1 value.
81	
82	    E.g. for step=4: valid values are 1, 5, 9, 13, ...
83	    For step=8: valid values are 1, 9, 17, 25, ...
84	    """
85	    return ((frames - 1) // step) * step + 1
86	
87	
88	def _quantize_frames_up(frames: int, step: int) -> int:
89	    """Quantize a frame count up to the nearest valid step*N+1 value."""
90	    if frames <= 1:
91	        return 1
92	    return ((frames + step - 2) // step) * step + 1

95	def _calculate_segment_stitched_offsets(
96	    segment_frames_expanded: list[int],
97	    frame_overlap_expanded: list[int],
98	) -> tuple[list[int], int]:
99	    """Return stitched segment start offsets and total stitched frame count."""
100	    total_stitched_frames = 0
101	    segment_stitched_offsets: list[int] = []
102	
103	    for idx, segment_total_frames in enumerate(segment_frames_expanded):
104	        if idx == 0:
105	            segment_stitched_offsets.append(0)
106	            total_stitched_frames = segment_total_frames
107	        else:
108	            overlap = frame_overlap_expanded[idx - 1] if idx - 1 < len(frame_overlap_expanded) else 0
109	            segment_start = total_stitched_frames - overlap
110	            segment_stitched_offsets.append(segment_start)
111	            total_stitched_frames = segment_start + segment_total_frames
112	
113	    return segment_stitched_offsets, total_stitched_frames

116	def _segment_has_travel_guidance_overlap(
117	    *,
118	    segment_index: int,
119	    segment_frames_expanded: list[int],
120	    segment_stitched_offsets: list[int],
121	    total_stitched_frames: int,
122	    travel_guidance_config: TravelGuidanceConfig,
123	) -> bool:
124	    """Check travel-guidance overlap using the stitched timeline semantics."""
125	    if travel_guidance_config.kind == "none":
126	        return False
127	    segment_start = segment_stitched_offsets[segment_index] if segment_index < len(segment_stitched_offsets) else 0
128	    segment_end = segment_start + (
129	        segment_frames_expanded[segment_index]
130	        if segment_index < len(segment_frames_expanded)
131	        else 0
132	    )
133	
134	    if travel_guidance_config.is_ltx_hybrid and travel_guidance_config.anchors:
135	        for anchor in travel_guidance_config.anchors:
136	            if segment_start <= anchor.frame_position < segment_end:
137	                return True
138	
139	    if not travel_guidance_config.videos:
140	        return bool(travel_guidance_config.guidance_video_url)
141	
142	    for video in travel_guidance_config.videos:
143	        video_start = video.start_frame
144	        video_end = total_stitched_frames if video.end_frame is None else video.end_frame
145	        if video_start < segment_end and video_end > segment_start:
146	            return True
147	
148	    return False

+
+    assert config.needs_ic_lora() is False
+
+

40	def _has_payload_value(value: Any) -> bool:
41	    """Return True when a payload field should count as "present"."""
42	    if value is None or value is False:

49	def _infer_allowed_kinds(model_name: str) -> set[str]:
50	    """Infer which travel guidance kinds are allowed for a model."""
51	    lowered = (model_name or "").lower()
52	
53	    if "ltx2" in lowered:
54	        pipeline_kind = None
55	        try:
56	            model_def = get_model_def(model_name)
57	            if isinstance(model_def, dict):
58	                pipeline_kind = model_def.get("ltx2_pipeline")
59	        except (ImportError, RuntimeError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError, AttributeError):
60	            pipeline_kind = None
61	
62	        is_distilled = pipeline_kind == "distilled" or (
63	            pipeline_kind is None and "distilled" in lowered
64	        )
65	        if is_distilled:
66	            return {"none", "ltx_control", "ltx_hybrid", "ltx_anchor", "uni3c"}
67	        return {"none"}
68	
69	    return {"none", "vace", "uni3c"}

220	    @staticmethod
221	    def _validate_exclusive_payload(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
222	        """Reject mixed public travel-guidance contracts."""
223	        if _has_payload_value(payload.get("structure_guidance")):
224	            raise ValueError("travel_guidance cannot be combined with structure_guidance")
225	
226	        conflicting = [
227	            key for key in _TRAVEL_GUIDANCE_LEGACY_KEYS if _has_payload_value(payload.get(key))
228	        ]
229	        if conflicting:
230	            raise ValueError(
231	                "travel_guidance cannot be combined with legacy structure guidance "
232	                f"fields: {sorted(conflicting)}"
233	            )
234	
235	    @staticmethod
236	    def _default_strength(kind: str, mode: str) -> float:
237	        if kind == "ltx_control":
238	            if mode in ("video", "cameraman"):
239	                return 1.0
240	            return 0.5
241	        if kind in ("vace", "uni3c"):
242	            return 1.0
243	        if kind in {"ltx_hybrid", "ltx_anchor"}:
244	            return 0.0
245	        return 0.0
246	
247	    @staticmethod
248	    def _apply_ltx_anchor_default_strengths(anchors_raw: Any) -> None:
249	        if not isinstance(anchors_raw, list):
250	            return
251	        if not anchors_raw or not all(isinstance(anchor, dict) for anchor in anchors_raw):
252	            return
253	        if any("strength" in anchor for anchor in anchors_raw):
254	            return
255	
256	        ordered = sorted(
257	            anchors_raw,
258	            key=lambda anchor: int(anchor.get("frame_position", 0) or 0),
259	        )
260	        last_index = len(ordered) - 1
261	        for index, anchor in enumerate(ordered):
262	            anchor["strength"] = 1.0 if index == 0 or index == last_index else 0.0
263	
264	    def to_structure_guidance_config(self) -> StructureGuidanceConfig:
265	        """Bridge into the existing WGP-facing structure guidance config."""
266	        if self.kind not in ("vace", "uni3c"):
267	            raise ValueError(
268	                f"travel_guidance kind '{self.kind}' cannot be converted to StructureGuidanceConfig"
269	            )
270	
271	        preprocessing = "none"
272	        target: Literal["vace", "uni3c"] = "vace"
273	
274	        if self.kind == "vace":
275	            target = "vace"
276	            preprocessing = "none" if self.mode == "raw" else self.mode
277	        elif self.kind == "uni3c":
278	            target = "uni3c"
279	
280	        return StructureGuidanceConfig(
281	            videos=list(self.videos),
282	            target=target,
283	            preprocessing=preprocessing,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
284	            strength=self.strength,
285	            canny_intensity=self.canny_intensity,
286	            depth_contrast=self.depth_contrast,
287	            step_window=self.step_window,
288	            frame_policy=self.frame_policy,
289	            zero_empty_frames=self.zero_empty_frames,
290	            keep_on_gpu=self.keep_on_gpu,
291	            _guidance_video_url=self._guidance_video_url,
292	            _frame_offset=self._frame_offset,
293	        )

295	    def needs_ic_lora(self) -> bool:
296	        """Return True when LTX control requires the union IC-LoRA."""
297	        if self.kind == "ltx_control":
298	            return self.mode in {"pose", "depth", "canny", "cameraman"}
299	        if self.kind == "ltx_hybrid":
300	            return self.has_control and self.mode in {"pose", "depth", "canny"}
301	        return False
302	
303	    def get_ic_lora_entry(self) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
304	        """Return the IC LoRA dict to inject into segment_loras, or None."""
305	        if not self.needs_ic_lora():
306	            return None
307	
308	        mode_entry = _IC_LORA_BY_MODE.get(self.mode)
309	        if mode_entry is not None:
310	            filename, url = mode_entry
311	        else:
312	            filename, url = _IC_LORA_UNION_CONTROL, None
313	
314	        strength = (
315	            self.control_strength if self.is_ltx_hybrid else self.strength
316	        )
317	        # Use URL when available so the download pipeline can fetch on demand;
318	        # bare filename relies on preload.
319	        return {
320	            "path": url or filename,
321	            "strength": strength,
322	            "name": f"ic-lora-{self.mode} (auto-injected)",
323	        }

325	    def get_preprocessor_type(self) -> str:
326	        """Return the preprocessor/compositing type used for this guidance."""
327	        if self.kind == "vace":
328	            return "raw" if self.mode == "raw" else self.mode
329	        if self.kind == "ltx_control":
330	            return "raw" if self.mode in {"video", "cameraman"} else self.mode
331	        if self.kind == "ltx_hybrid":
332	            if not self.has_control:
333	                return "raw"
334	            return "raw" if self.mode == "video" else self.mode
335	        if self.kind == "ltx_anchor":
336	            return "raw"
337	        if self.kind == "uni3c":
338	            return "uni3c"
339	        return "raw"

341	    def to_segment_payload(self, frame_offset: int) -> Dict[str, Any]:
342	        """Serialize to the segment-level ``travel_guidance`` payload."""
343	        if self.kind == "none":
344	            return {"kind": "none"}
345	        if self.kind == "ltx_anchor":
346	            return {
347	                "kind": self.kind,
348	                "anchors": [anchor.to_dict() for anchor in self.anchors],
349	                "_frame_offset": frame_offset,

351	
352	        payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
353	            "kind": self.kind,
354	            "videos": [video.to_dict() for video in self.videos],
355	            "strength": self.strength,
356	            "_frame_offset": frame_offset,
357	        }
358	
359	        if self.mode:
360	            payload["mode"] = self.mode
361	        if self.kind in {"vace", "ltx_control"}:
362	            payload["canny_intensity"] = self.canny_intensity
363	            payload["depth_contrast"] = self.depth_contrast
364	        if self.kind == "ltx_hybrid":
365	            payload["anchors"] = [anchor.to_dict() for anchor in self.anchors]
366	            payload["control_strength"] = self.control_strength
367	            payload["canny_intensity"] = self.canny_intensity
368	            payload["depth_contrast"] = self.depth_contrast
369	            if self.audio is not None:
370	                payload["audio"] = self.audio.to_dict()
371	        if self.kind == "uni3c":
372	            payload["step_window"] = list(self.step_window)
373	            payload["frame_policy"] = self.frame_policy
374	            payload["zero_empty_frames"] = self.zero_empty_frames
375	            payload["keep_on_gpu"] = self.keep_on_gpu
376	        if self._guidance_video_url:
377	            payload["_guidance_video_url"] = self._guidance_video_url
378	
379	        return payload

## Background

IC-LoRA = "In-Context LoRA." For LTX, this is the union IC-LoRA that Lightricks ships to do pose/depth/canny guidance: you feed the model a preprocessed control video (skeleton pose, depth map, or canny edges) as a parallel latent stream, and the LoRA routes that conditioning through the transformer to steer generation.

In the travel_guidance contract, our code auto-injects this LoRA when `travel_guidance.kind == "ltx_control"` and `mode` is one of `pose`, `depth`, or `canny`. I want to know how this is done in the official repo vs our repo.

59	def load_image_to_tensor_with_resize_and_crop(
60	    image_input: Union[str, Image.Image],
61	    target_height: int = 512,
62	    target_width: int = 768,
63	    just_crop: bool = False,
64	) -> torch.Tensor:
65	    """Load and process an image into a tensor.
66	
67	    Args:
68	        image_input: Either a file path (str) or a PIL Image object
69	        target_height: Desired height of output tensor
70	        target_width: Desired width of output tensor
71	        just_crop: If True, only crop the image to the target size without resizing
72	    """
73	    if isinstance(image_input, str):
74	        image = Image.open(image_input).convert("RGB")
75	    elif isinstance(image_input, Image.Image):
76	        image = image_input
77	    else:
78	        raise ValueError("image_input must be either a file path or a PIL Image object")
79	
80	    input_width, input_height = image.size
81	    aspect_ratio_target = target_width / target_height
82	    aspect_ratio_frame = input_width / input_height
83	    if aspect_ratio_frame > aspect_ratio_target:
84	        new_width = int(input_height * aspect_ratio_target)
85	        new_height = input_height
86	        x_start = (input_width - new_width) // 2
87	        y_start = 0
88	    else:
89	        new_width = input_width
90	        new_height = int(input_width / aspect_ratio_target)
91	        x_start = 0
92	        y_start = (input_height - new_height) // 2
93	
94	    image = image.crop((x_start, y_start, x_start + new_width, y_start + new_height))
95	    if not just_crop:
96	        image = image.resize((target_width, target_height))
97	
98	    frame_tensor = TVF.to_tensor(image)  # PIL -> tensor (C, H, W), [0,1]
99	    frame_tensor = TVF.gaussian_blur(frame_tensor, kernel_size=3, sigma=1.0)
100	    frame_tensor_hwc = frame_tensor.permute(1, 2, 0)  # (C, H, W) -> (H, W, C)
101	    frame_tensor_hwc = crf_compressor.compress(frame_tensor_hwc)
102	    frame_tensor = frame_tensor_hwc.permute(2, 0, 1) * 255.0  # (H, W, C) -> (C, H, W)
103	    frame_tensor = (frame_tensor / 127.5) - 1.0
104	    # Create 5D tensor: (batch_size=1, channels=3, num_frames=1, height, width)
105	    return frame_tensor.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(2)

108	def calculate_padding(
109	    source_height: int, source_width: int, target_height: int, target_width: int
110	) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
111	
112	    # Calculate total padding needed
113	    pad_height = target_height - source_height
114	    pad_width = target_width - source_width
115	
116	    # Calculate padding for each side
117	    pad_top = pad_height // 2
118	    pad_bottom = pad_height - pad_top  # Handles odd padding
119	    pad_left = pad_width // 2
120	    pad_right = pad_width - pad_left  # Handles odd padding
121	
122	    # Return padded tensor
123	    # Padding format is (left, right, top, bottom)
124	    padding = (pad_left, pad_right, pad_top, pad_bottom)
125	    return padding

128	def convert_prompt_to_filename(text: str, max_len: int = 20) -> str:
129	    # Remove non-letters and convert to lowercase
130	    clean_text = "".join(
131	        char.lower() for char in text if char.isalpha() or char.isspace()
132	    )
133	
134	    # Split into words

136	
137	    # Build result string keeping track of length

139	    current_length = 0
140

143	        new_length = current_length + len(word)
144	
145	        if new_length <= max_len:
146	            result.append(word)
147	            current_length += len(word)
148	        else:
149	            break
150	
151	    return "-".join(result)

389	def infer(config: InferenceConfig):

393	    if not os.path.isfile(ltxv_model_name_or_path):

397	            repo_type="model",
398	        )

400	        ltxv_model_path = ltxv_model_name_or_path
401	
402	    spatial_upscaler_model_name_or_path = pipeline_config.get(

404	    )

406	        spatial_upscaler_model_name_or_path

409	            repo_id="Lightricks/LTX-Video",

418	    conditioning_start_frames = config.conditioning_start_frames

420	    # Validate conditioning arguments
421	    if conditioning_media_paths:

425	        if not conditioning_start_frames:

542	        if conditioning_media_paths

544	    )
545	
546	    stg_mode = pipeline_config.get("stg_mode", "attention_values")
547	    del pipeline_config["stg_mode"]
548	    if stg_mode.lower() == "stg_av" or stg_mode.lower() == "attention_values":
549	        skip_layer_strategy = SkipLayerStrategy.AttentionValues
550	    elif stg_mode.lower() == "stg_as" or stg_mode.lower() == "attention_skip":
551	        skip_layer_strategy = SkipLayerStrategy.AttentionSkip
552	    elif stg_mode.lower() == "stg_r" or stg_mode.lower() == "residual":
553	        skip_layer_strategy = SkipLayerStrategy.Residual
554	    elif stg_mode.lower() == "stg_t" or stg_mode.lower() == "transformer_block":
555	        skip_layer_strategy = SkipLayerStrategy.TransformerBlock
556	    else:
557	        raise ValueError(f"Invalid spatiotemporal guidance mode: {stg_mode}")
558	
559	    # Prepare input for the pipeline
560	    sample = {

562	        "prompt_attention_mask": None,
563	        "negative_prompt": config.negative_prompt,
564	        "negative_prompt_attention_mask": None,
565	    }
566	
567	    generator = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(config.seed)
568	
569	    images = pipeline(
570	        **pipeline_config,
571	        skip_layer_strategy=skip_layer_strategy,
572	        generator=generator,
573	        output_type="pt",
574	        callback_on_step_end=None,
575	        height=height_padded,
576	        width=width_padded,
577	        num_frames=num_frames_padded,
578	        frame_rate=config.frame_rate,
579	        **sample,
580	        media_items=media_item,
581	        conditioning_items=conditioning_items,
582	        is_video=True,
583	        vae_per_channel_normalize=True,
584	        image_cond_noise_scale=config.image_cond_noise_scale,

586	        offload_to_cpu=offload_to_cpu,
587	        device=device,
588	        enhance_prompt=enhance_prompt,
589	    ).images
590	
591	    # Crop the padded images to the desired resolution and number of frames
592	    (pad_left, pad_right, pad_top, pad_bottom) = padding
593	    pad_bottom = -pad_bottom
594	    pad_right = -pad_right
595	    if pad_bottom == 0:

627	            )
628	
629	            # Write video
630	            with imageio.get_writer(output_filename, fps=fps) as video:

634	        logger.warning(f"Output saved to {output_filename}")

637	def prepare_conditioning(
638	    conditioning_media_paths: List[str],
639	    conditioning_strengths: List[float],
640	    conditioning_start_frames: List[int],
641	    height: int,
642	    width: int,
643	    num_frames: int,
644	    padding: tuple[int, int, int, int],
645	    pipeline: LTXVideoPipeline,
646	) -> Optional[List[ConditioningItem]]:
647	    """Prepare conditioning items based on input media paths and their parameters.
648	
649	    Args:
650	        conditioning_media_paths: List of paths to conditioning media (images or videos)
651	        conditioning_strengths: List of conditioning strengths for each media item
652	        conditioning_start_frames: List of frame indices where each item should be applied
653	        height: Height of the output frames
654	        width: Width of the output frames
655	        num_frames: Number of frames in the output video
656	        padding: Padding to apply to the frames
657	        pipeline: LTXVideoPipeline object used for condition video trimming
658	
659	    Returns:
660	        A list of ConditioningItem objects.
661	    """
662	    conditioning_items = []
663	    for path, strength, start_frame in zip(
664	        conditioning_media_paths, conditioning_strengths, conditioning_start_frames
665	    ):
666	        num_input_frames = orig_num_input_frames = get_media_num_frames(path)
667	        if hasattr(pipeline, "trim_conditioning_sequence") and callable(
668	            getattr(pipeline, "trim_conditioning_sequence")
669	        ):
670	            num_input_frames = pipeline.trim_conditioning_sequence(
671	                start_frame, orig_num_input_frames, num_frames
672	            )
673	        if num_input_frames < orig_num_input_frames:
674	            logger.warning(
675	                f"Trimming conditioning video {path} from {orig_num_input_frames} to {num_input_frames} frames."
676	            )
677	
678	        media_tensor = load_media_file(
679	            media_path=path,
680	            height=height,
681	            width=width,
682	            max_frames=num_input_frames,
683	            padding=padding,
684	            just_crop=True,
685	        )
686	        conditioning_items.append(ConditioningItem(media_tensor, start_frame, strength))
687	    return conditioning_items
688	
689	
690	def get_media_num_frames(media_path: str) -> int:
691	    is_video = any(
692	        media_path.lower().endswith(ext) for ext in [".mp4", ".avi", ".mov", ".mkv"]
693	    )
694	    num_frames = 1
695	    if is_video:
696	        reader = imageio.get_reader(media_path)
697	        num_frames = reader.count_frames()
698	        reader.close()
699	    return num_frames
700	
701	
702	def load_media_file(
703	    media_path: str,
704	    height: int,
705	    width: int,
706	    max_frames: int,
707	    padding: tuple[int, int, int, int],
708	    just_crop: bool = False,
709	) -> torch.Tensor:
710	    is_video = any(
711	        media_path.lower().endswith(ext) for ext in [".mp4", ".avi", ".mov", ".mkv"]
712	    )
713	    if is_video:
714	        reader = imageio.get_reader(media_path)
715	        num_input_frames = min(reader.count_frames(), max_frames)
716	
717	        # Read and preprocess the relevant frames from the video file.
718	        frames = []
719	        for i in range(num_input_frames):
720	            frame = Image.fromarray(reader.get_data(i))
721	            frame_tensor = load_image_to_tensor_with_resize_and_crop(
722	                frame, height, width, just_crop=just_crop
723	            )
724	            frame_tensor = torch.nn.functional.pad(frame_tensor, padding)
725	            frames.append(frame_tensor)
726	        reader.close()
727	
728	        # Stack frames along the temporal dimension
729	        media_tensor = torch.cat(frames, dim=2)
730	    else:  # Input image
731	        media_tensor = load_image_to_tensor_with_resize_and_crop(
732	            media_path, height, width, just_crop=just_crop
733	        )
734	        media_tensor = torch.nn.functional.pad(media_tensor, padding)
735	    return media_tensor
736

49	def _infer_allowed_kinds(model_name: str) -> set[str]:
50	    """Infer which travel guidance kinds are allowed for a model."""
51	    lowered = (model_name or "").lower()
52	
53	    if "ltx2" in lowered:
54	        pipeline_kind = None
55	        try:
56	            model_def = get_model_def(model_name)
57	            if isinstance(model_def, dict):
58	                pipeline_kind = model_def.get("ltx2_pipeline")
59	        except (ImportError, RuntimeError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError, AttributeError):
60	            pipeline_kind = None
61	
62	        is_distilled = pipeline_kind == "distilled" or (
63	            pipeline_kind is None and "distilled" in lowered
64	        )
65	        if is_distilled:
66	            return {"none", "ltx_control", "ltx_hybrid", "ltx_anchor", "uni3c"}
67	        return {"none"}
68	
69	    return {"none", "vace", "uni3c"}

220	    @staticmethod
221	    def _validate_exclusive_payload(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
222	        """Reject mixed public travel-guidance contracts."""
223	        if _has_payload_value(payload.get("structure_guidance")):
224	            raise ValueError("travel_guidance cannot be combined with structure_guidance")
225	
226	        conflicting = [
227	            key for key in _TRAVEL_GUIDANCE_LEGACY_KEYS if _has_payload_value(payload.get(key))
228	        ]
229	        if conflicting:
230	            raise ValueError(
231	                "travel_guidance cannot be combined with legacy structure guidance "
232	                f"fields: {sorted(conflicting)}"
233	            )

235	    @staticmethod
236	    def _default_strength(kind: str, mode: str) -> float:
237	        if kind == "ltx_control":
238	            if mode in ("video", "cameraman"):
239	                return 1.0
240	            return 0.5
241	        if kind in ("vace", "uni3c"):
242	            return 1.0
243	        if kind in {"ltx_hybrid", "ltx_anchor"}:
244	            return 0.0
245	        return 0.0
246	
247	    @staticmethod
248	    def _apply_ltx_anchor_default_strengths(anchors_raw: Any) -> Any:
249	        if not isinstance(anchors_raw, list):
250	            return anchors_raw
251	        if not anchors_raw or not all(isinstance(anchor, dict) for anchor in anchors_raw):
252	            return anchors_raw
253	        if any("strength" in anchor for anchor in anchors_raw):
254	            return anchors_raw
255	
256	        copies = [dict(anchor) for anchor in anchors_raw]
257	        ordered = sorted(
258	            copies,
259	            key=lambda anchor: int(anchor.get("frame_position", 0) or 0),
260	        )
261	        last_index = len(ordered) - 1
262	        for index, anchor in enumerate(ordered):
263	            anchor["strength"] = 1.0 if index == 0 or index == last_index else 0.0
264	        return copies

469	                if not 0.0 <= anchor.strength <= 1.0:

472	                    )

474	        if self.kind == "ltx_hybrid":
475	            if self.audio is not None:
476	                if self.audio.source not in {"external", "control_track"}:
477	                    errors.append(

479	                    )
480	                if self.audio.source == "control_track" and not self.has_control:
481	                    errors.append(

485	                    errors.append(

487	                    )

489	                    errors.append(

491	                    )
492	
493	        return errors

22	def get_structure_preprocessor(
23	    structure_type: str,
24	    motion_strength: float = 1.0,
25	    canny_intensity: float = 1.0,
26	    depth_contrast: float = 1.0,
27	):
28	    """
29	    Get preprocessor function for structure video guidance.
30	
31	    We import and instantiate the preprocessor ourselves, then run it
32	    on the structure video frames to generate RGB visualizations.
33	
34	    Args:
35	        structure_type: Type of preprocessing ("flow", "canny", or "depth")
36	        motion_strength: Only affects flow - scales flow vector magnitude
37	        canny_intensity: Only affects canny - scales edge boldness
38	        depth_contrast: Only affects depth - adjusts depth map contrast
39	
40	    Returns:
41	        Function that takes a list of frames (np.ndarray)
42	        and returns a list of processed frames (RGB visualizations).
43	    """
44	    generation_logger.debug_anomaly("PREPROCESSOR_DEBUG", f"Initializing preprocessor with structure_type='{structure_type}'")
45	
46	    if structure_type == "flow":
47	        wan_dir = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent.parent / "Wan2GP"
48	        FlowAnnotator = get_flow_annotator_class()
49	
50	        # Ensure RAFT model is downloaded
51	        flow_model_path = wan_dir / "ckpts" / "flow" / "raft-things.pth"
52	        if not flow_model_path.exists():
53	            generation_logger.debug_anomaly("FLOW", f"RAFT model not found, downloading from Hugging Face...")
54	            try:
55	                from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

57	                hf_hub_download(

59	                    filename="raft-things.pth",
60	                    local_dir=str(wan_dir / 'ckpts'),
61	                    subfolder="flow"

64	            except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as e:
65	                raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to download RAFT model: {e}. Please manually download from https://huggingface.co/DeepBeepMeep/Wan2.1/tree/main/flow") from e
66

69

72	        def process_with_motion_strength(frames):
73	            """Process frames with motion_strength applied to flow visualizations."""
74	            # Get raw flow fields from RAFT
75	            flow_fields, _ = annotator.forward(frames)
76	
77	            # Scale flow fields by motion_strength
78	            scaled_flows = [flow * motion_strength for flow in flow_fields]
79	
80	            # Generate visualizations from scaled flows
81	            flow_visualizations = [flow_viz.flow_to_image(flow) for flow in scaled_flows]
82	
83	            # Match FlowVisAnnotator behavior: duplicate first frame
84	            return flow_visualizations[:1] + flow_visualizations
85	
86	        if abs(motion_strength - 1.0) > 1e-6:
87	            generation_logger.debug_anomaly("FLOW", f"Applying motion_strength={motion_strength} to flow visualizations")

152	            except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as e:
153	                raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to download Depth Anything V2 model: {e}. Please manually download from https://huggingface.co/DeepBeepMeep/Wan2.1/tree/main/depth") from e
154	
155	        cfg = {
156	            "PRETRAINED_MODEL": str(depth_model_path),
157	            "MODEL_VARIANT": variant
158	        }
159	        annotator = DepthV2VideoAnnotator(cfg)
160	
161	        def process_depth(frames):
162	            # Get base depth maps
163	            depth_frames = annotator.forward(frames)
164	
165	            # Apply contrast adjustment if not 1.0
166	            if abs(depth_contrast - 1.0) > 1e-6:
167	                adjusted_frames = []
168	                for frame in depth_frames:
169	                    # Convert to float, normalize, apply contrast, denormalize
170	                    frame_float = frame.astype(np.float32) / 255.0
171	                    # Apply contrast around midpoint (0.5)
172	                    adjusted = ((frame_float - 0.5) * depth_contrast + 0.5).clip(0, 1)
173	                    adjusted = (adjusted * 255).astype(np.uint8)
174	                    adjusted_frames.append(adjusted)
175	                generation_logger.debug_anomaly("STRUCTURE_PREPROCESS", f"Applied depth contrast: {depth_contrast}")
176	                return adjusted_frames
177	            return depth_frames
178	
179	        return process_depth
180	
181	    elif structure_type == "pose":
182	        wan_dir = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent.parent / "Wan2GP"
183	        PoseBodyFaceVideoAnnotator = get_pose_body_face_video_annotator_class()
184	
185	        det_model_path = wan_dir / "ckpts" / "pose" / "yolox_l.onnx"
186	        pose_model_path = wan_dir / "ckpts" / "pose" / "dw-ll_ucoco_384.onnx"
187	
188	        missing_models = [
189	            str(model_path)
190	            for model_path in (det_model_path, pose_model_path)
191	            if not model_path.exists()
192	        ]
193	        if missing_models:
194	            raise RuntimeError(
195	                "Missing DWPose models required for pose preprocessing: "
196	                + ", ".join(missing_models)
197	            )
198	
199	        cfg = {
200	            "DETECTION_MODEL": str(det_model_path),
201	            "POSE_MODEL": str(pose_model_path),
202	            "RESIZE_SIZE": 1024,
203	        }
204	        annotator = PoseBodyFaceVideoAnnotator(cfg)
205	
206	        def process_pose(frames):
207	            return annotator.forward(frames)
208	
209	        return process_pose
210	
211	    elif structure_type in ("raw", "uni3c"):
212	        # Raw/uni3c use raw video frames as guidance - no preprocessing needed
213	        # For uni3c, frames are passed directly to WGP's uni3c encoder
214	        generation_logger.debug_anomaly("STRUCTURE_PREPROCESS", f"{structure_type} type: returning frames without preprocessing")
215	        return lambda frames: frames
216	
217	    else:
218	        raise ValueError(
219	            f"Unsupported structure_type: {structure_type}. Must be 'flow', 'canny', "
220	            "'depth', 'pose', 'raw', or 'uni3c'"
221	        )
222	
223	
224	def process_structure_frames(
225	    frames: List[np.ndarray],
226	    structure_type: str,
227	    motion_strength: float,
228	    canny_intensity: float,
229	    depth_contrast: float,
230	) -> List[np.ndarray]:
231	    """
232	    Process frames with chosen preprocessor, ensuring consistent output count.
233	
234	    Handles the N-1 problem for optical flow (which returns N-1 flows for N frames).
235	
236	    Args:
237	        frames: List of input frames to preprocess
238	        structure_type: Type of preprocessing ("flow", "canny", "depth", "pose", "raw", or "uni3c")
239	        motion_strength: Strength parameter for flow
240	        canny_intensity: Intensity parameter for canny
241	        depth_contrast: Contrast parameter for depth
242	
243	    Returns:
244	        List of RGB visualization frames (length = len(frames))
245	    """
246	    # Handle raw type - no preprocessing needed
247	    if structure_type == "raw":
248	        generation_logger.debug_anomaly("STRUCTURE_PREPROCESS", f"Raw type: returning {len(frames)} frames without preprocessing")
249	        return frames
250	
251	    generation_logger.debug_anomaly("STRUCTURE_PREPROCESS", f"Processing {len(frames)} frames with '{structure_type}' preprocessor...")
252	
253	    preprocessor = get_structure_preprocessor(
254	        structure_type,
255	        motion_strength,
256	        canny_intensity,
257	        depth_contrast,
258	    )
259	
260	    import time
261	    start_time = time.time()
262	    processed_frames = preprocessor(frames)
263	    duration = time.time() - start_time
264	
265	    generation_logger.debug_anomaly("STRUCTURE_PREPROCESS", f"Preprocessing completed in {duration:.2f}s")
266	
267	    # Handle N-1 case for optical flow
268	    if structure_type == "flow" and len(processed_frames) == len(frames) - 1:
269	        # Duplicate last flow frame to match input count
270	        processed_frames.append(processed_frames[-1].copy())
271	        generation_logger.debug_anomaly("STRUCTURE_PREPROCESS", f"Duplicated last flow frame ({len(frames)-1} \u2192 {len(frames)} frames)")
272	
273	    # Validate output count
274	    if len(processed_frames) != len(frames):
275	        raise ValueError(
276	            f"Preprocessor '{structure_type}' returned {len(processed_frames)} frames "
277	            f"for {len(frames)} input frames. Expected {len(frames)} output frames."
278	        )
279	
280	    return processed_frames
281

## IC-LoRA Investigation

### Official LTX-Video
**Primitive location:** `/tmp/ltx-official/ltx_video/pipelines/pipeline_ltx_video.py:194-211`
- `ConditioningItem` dataclass defines conditioning media with `media_item` (torch.Tensor), `media_frame_number` (int), and `conditioning_strength` (float). Optional `media_x`/`media_y` for positional control.

**How control video is delivered:** `/tmp/ltx-official/ltx_video/inference.py:369-386` and `637-687`
- CLI arguments: `--conditioning_media_paths` (list of paths), `--conditioning_start_frames` (list of frame indices), `--conditioning_strengths` (optional, defaults to 1.0 per item).
- `prepare_conditioning()` loads media files (image or video) and wraps them as `ConditioningItem` objects with frame numbers and strengths.
- Media loaded via `load_media_file()` which resizes/crops to target height/width, applies padding, and normalizes to [-1, 1] range.
- In pipeline: `conditioning_items` parameter passed to `LTXVideoPipeline.__call__()` at `/tmp/ltx-official/ltx_video/pipelines/pipeline_ltx_video.py:784`.

**User-facing API:** `/tmp/ltx-official/inference.py:316-386`
- `InferenceConfig` dataclass with fields: `conditioning_media_paths`, `conditioning_strengths`, `conditioning_start_frames`.
- CLI: `python inference.py --prompt "..." --conditioning_media_paths PATH --conditioning_start_frames FRAME --height H --width W --num_frames N --seed S --pipeline_config CONFIG.yaml`
- README mentions three IC-LoRA models but control is agnostic to the LoRA version — conditioning is generic latent concatenation with downstream LoRA steering.

**Weight loading:** No evidence found. Official repo does not load or apply IC-LoRA weights in the codebase. LoRAs are expected to be loaded separately (via diffusers' LoRA loading machinery or external tooling like ComfyUI). The README references official IC-LoRAs (depth, pose, canny, detailer) from HuggingFace Lightricks org, but no weight file paths are hardcoded in `/tmp/ltx-official/`.

**Tests / examples:** `/tmp/ltx-official/tests/test_inference.py` exists but no control-specific test found. No example configs or scripts in `configs/` that reference conditioning. README documents control workflow at section "**Control Models**" and links to ComfyUI example workflow `ic_lora.json`.

---

### Reigh-worker
**Auto-injection decision:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-worker/source/task_handlers/tasks/task_registry.py:955-971`
- Triggered when `structure.structure_config` is `TravelGuidanceConfig` instance AND `structure_config.get_ic_lora_entry()` returns non-None.
- `needs_ic_lora()` check at `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-worker/source/core/params/travel_guidance.py:297-303`: returns True for `kind="ltx_control"` with `mode in {"pose", "depth", "canny", "cameraman"}`, or `kind="ltx_hybrid"` with control + mode in those four.

**LoRA file and source:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-worker/source/core/params/travel_guidance.py:29-37`
- Registry `_IC_LORA_BY_MODE` defines mode-specific LoRAs. Currently only `"cameraman"` has a custom entry: `[REDACTED]` with HuggingFace URL.
- Default fallback: `_IC_LORA_UNION_CONTROL = "ltx-2.3-22b-ic-lora-union-control-ref0.5.safetensors"` (no URL, relies on preload).
- `get_ic_lora_entry()` at line 305-325: returns dict with `{"path": url_or_filename, "strength": control_strength_or_strength, "name": f"ic-lora-{mode}"}`.

**Parameters wired:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-worker/source/task_handlers/tasks/task_registry.py:973-987`
- Strength extracted from `ic_entry["strength"]` (either `control_strength` for hybrid or `strength` for ltx_control).
- Wired as: `generation_params["activated_loras"]` (list of paths), `generation_params["loras_multipliers"]` (space-separated strength strings).
- No rank parameter exposed; LoRA rank fixed at training time in the weight file itself.

**Control-video preprocessing chain:**
- **Pose:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-worker/source/media/structure/preprocessors.py:181-209`
  - Uses `PoseBodyFaceVideoAnnotator` (DWPose).
  - Models: `yolox_l.onnx` (detection), `dw-ll_ucoco_384.onnx` (pose).
  - Returns skeleton visualization frames via `annotator.forward(frames)`.
  
- **Depth:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-worker/source/media/structure/preprocessors.py:132-179`
  - Uses `DepthV2VideoAnnotator` (Depth Anything V2, variant="vitl").
  - Applies contrast adjustment via `depth_contrast` parameter (default 1.0).
  - Contrast applied as: `((frame_float - 0.5) * depth_contrast + 0.5).clip(0, 1)`.
  
- **Canny:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-worker/source/media/structure/preprocessors.py:91-130`
  - Uses `CannyVideoAnnotator`.
  - Applies intensity scaling via `canny_intensity` parameter (default 1.0).
  - Intensity applied as: `(frame.astype(np.float32) * canny_intensity).clip(0, 255)`.

**Vendored pipeline consumption:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-worker/Wan2GP/models/ltx2/ltx_pipelines/ic_lora.py:46-392`
- `ICLoraPipeline` class accepts `loras: list[LoraPathStrengthAndSDOps]` in constructor (line 61).
- Two-stage pipeline: Stage 1 applies IC-LoRA (`stage_1_model_ledger.transformer()` uses loras), Stage 2 upsamples without LoRA (line 81: `loras=[]`).
- `video_conditioning: list[tuple[str, float]]` parameter passed to `__call__()` at line 101.
- Conditioning created via `_create_conditionings()` (line 360-392) which calls `video_conditionings_by_keyframe()` to encode control video frames into `ConditioningItem` objects.
- LoRAs applied via `update_loras_slists()` at line 156-162 (Stage 1) and 259-265 (Stage 2).

**Known gotchas in comments:**
- Line 955 in task_registry.py: "Auto-inject IC LoRA when travel guidance requires it" — only pose/depth/canny/cameraman modes trigger injection, not "video" or "raw" modes.
- Line 961-968: Deduplication by basename — if IC LoRA already in segment_loras, updates strength instead of adding duplicate.
- Line 81-82 in ic_lora.py: Stage 2 explicitly sets `loras=[]` — IC-LoRA only applied in Stage 1, Stage 2 refines upsampled video without control signal.
- `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh-workspace/reigh-worker/source/media/structure/preprocessors.py:268-271`: Handles optical flow N-1 problem by duplicating last frame to match input count.

---

## Observations

- **Official LTX is control-agnostic:** The pipeline accepts generic `ConditioningItem` objects without knowing pose/depth/canny semantics. Control type is determined by which IC-LoRA the user loads externally (ComfyUI, diffusers, etc.).

- **Reigh-worker auto-injects and preprocesses:** Automatically selects and loads the correct union IC-LoRA based on `travel_guidance.mode`, and runs the appropriate preprocessor (DWPose, Depth Anything V2, or Canny) to encode the control video into the latent stream. This is a higher-level orchestration compared to the official repo's generic conditioning API.

- **Strength routing differs:** Official LTX uses per-item `conditioning_strength` on each `ConditioningItem`. Reigh-worker uses global `strength` (ltx_control) or `control_strength` (ltx_hybrid) for the entire IC-LoRA multiplier.

- **Two-stage + LoRA phase-switching:** The vendored `ICLoraPipeline` applies IC-LoRA only in Stage 1 (initial generation), then Stage 2 (upsampling) uses the same transformer without LoRA to refine. Reigh-worker's task_registry injects the LoRA path; the pipeline itself handles strength and phase-specific application via `update_loras_slists()`.

## Investigation 3 — Detailer: inline stage-2 vs post-gen refinement

This is a design question, not a code question. Investigate both patterns:

**Inline two-stage** (what we currently skip with `loras=[]` in stage 2):
- Pros: shared latent context, no re-encoding cost, same call site.
- Cons: tied to one diffusion call, harder to iterate on the detail pass independently, can't swap models.

**Post-gen refinement** (user's suggested direction — decode the stage-1 output, then run a fresh detailer pass on the decoded video):
- Pros: decoupled, can use a different model entirely (WAN detailer, RIFE, different LTX variant), can retry just the detail pass, can batch across many gens.
- Cons: extra VAE decode + encode round trip (quality loss reported by community), extra compute.

Search both the official LTX README and deepbeepmeep/Wan2GP for any guidance on which pattern they recommend. Check the `docs/` folder of both repos. Report what each recommends, and whether there's a technical reason it has to be inline (e.g., the detailer LoRA expects specific denoising-state features only available mid-sample).

61	# Introduction
62	
63	LTX-Video is the first DiT-based video generation model that contains all core capabilities of modern video generation in one model: synchronized audio and video, high fidelity, multiple performance modes, production-ready outputs, API access, and open access. It can generate up to 50 FPS videos at native 4K resolution with synchronized audio in one pass.
64	The model is trained on a large-scale dataset of diverse videos and can generate high-resolution videos with realistic and diverse content.
65	
66	The model supports image-to-video, multi-keyframe conditioning, keyframe-based animation, video extension (both forward and backward), video-to-video transformations, and any combination of these features.

84	# News

86	## October 23, 2025: LTX-2 Announced
87	
88	Today we announced our newest foundation model, LTX-2. LTX-2 represents a major leap forward from our previous model, LTXV 0.9.8. Here’s what’s new:
89	* **Audio + Video, Together**: Visuals and sound are generated in one coherent process, with motion, dialogue, ambience, and music flowing simultaneously.
90	* **4K Fidelity**: Professional-grade precision with native 4K and up to 50 fps, sharp textures, clean motion, and synchronized audio.
91	* **Longer Generations**: LTX-2 supports longer, continuous clips with synchronized audio up to 10 seconds.
92	* **Low Cost & Efficiency**: Up to 50% lower compute cost than competing models, powered by a multi-GPU inference stack.
93	* **Creative Control**: Multi-keyframe conditioning, 3D camera logic, and LoRA fine-tuning deliver frame-level precision and style consistency.
94	
95	For more details, please see our [blog post](https://website.ltx.video/blog/introducing-ltx-2). LTX-2 model weights, code, and benchmarks will be released to the community later in 2025.

201	# Quick Start Guide
202	
203	## Online inference
204	The model is accessible right away via the following links:
205	- [LTX-Studio image-to-video (13B-mix)](https://app.ltx.studio/motion-workspace?videoModel=ltxv-13b)
206	- [LTX-Studio image-to-video (13B distilled)](https://app.ltx.studio/motion-workspace?videoModel=ltxv)
207	- [Fal.ai image-to-video (13B full)](https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/ltx-video-13b-dev/image-to-video)
208	- [Fal.ai image-to-video (13B distilled)](https://fal.ai/models/fal-ai/ltx-video-13b-distilled/image-to-video)
209	- [Replicate image-to-video](https://replicate.com/lightricks/ltx-video)

211	## Run locally
212	
213	### Installation
214	The codebase was tested with Python 3.10.5, CUDA version 12.2, and supports PyTorch >= 2.1.2.
215	On macOS, MPS was tested with PyTorch 2.3.0, and should support PyTorch == 2.3 or >= 2.6.
216	
217	```bash
218	git clone https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-Video.git
219	cd LTX-Video
220	
221	# create env
222	python -m venv env
223	source env/bin/activate
224	python -m pip install -e .\[inference\]
225	```
226	
227	#### FP8 Kernels (optional)
228	
229	[FP8 kernels](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTXVideo-Q8-Kernels) developed for LTX-Video provide performance boost on supported graphics cards (Ada architecture and later). To install FP8 kernels, follow the instructions in that repository.
230	
231	### Inference
232	
233	📝 **Note:** For best results, we recommend using our [ComfyUI](#comfyui-integration) workflow. We're working on updating the inference.py script to match the high quality and output fidelity of ComfyUI.
234	
235	To use our model, please follow the inference code in [inference.py](./inference.py):
236	
237	#### For image-to-video generation:
238	
239	```bash
240	python inference.py --prompt "PROMPT" --conditioning_media_paths IMAGE_PATH --conditioning_start_frames 0 --height HEIGHT --width WIDTH --num_frames NUM_FRAMES --seed SEED --pipeline_config configs/ltxv-13b-0.9.8-distilled.yaml
241	```
242	
243	#### Extending a video:
244	
245	📝 **Note:** Input video segments must contain a multiple of 8 frames plus 1 (e.g., 9, 17, 25, etc.), and the target frame number should be a multiple of 8.
246	
247	
248	```bash
249	python inference.py --prompt "PROMPT" --conditioning_media_paths VIDEO_PATH --conditioning_start_frames START_FRAME --height HEIGHT --width WIDTH --num_frames NUM_FRAMES --seed SEED --pipeline_config configs/ltxv-13b-0.9.8-distilled.yaml
250	```
251	
252	#### For video generation with multiple conditions:
253	
254	You can now generate a video conditioned on a set of images and/or short video segments.
255	Simply provide a list of paths to the images or video segments you want to condition on, along with their target frame numbers in the generated video. You can also specify the conditioning strength for each item (default: 1.0).
256	
257	```bash
258	python inference.py --prompt "PROMPT" --conditioning_media_paths IMAGE_OR_VIDEO_PATH_1 IMAGE_OR_VIDEO_PATH_2 --conditioning_start_frames TARGET_FRAME_1 TARGET_FRAME_2 --height HEIGHT --width WIDTH --num_frames NUM_FRAMES --seed SEED --pipeline_config configs/ltxv-13b-0.9.8-distilled.yaml
259	```
260	
261	### Using as a library
262	
263	```python
264	from ltx_video.inference import infer, InferenceConfig
265	
266	infer(
267	    InferenceConfig(
268	        pipeline_config="configs/ltxv-13b-0.9.8-distilled.yaml",
269	        prompt=PROMPT,
270	        height=HEIGHT,
271	        width=WIDTH,
272	        num_frames=NUM_FRAMES,
273	        output_path="output.mp4",
274	    )
275	)
276	```

286	# Model User Guide
287	
288	## 📝 Prompt Engineering
289	
290	When writing prompts, focus on detailed, chronological descriptions of actions and scenes. Include specific movements, appearances, camera angles, and environmental details - all in a single flowing paragraph. Start directly with the action, and keep descriptions literal and precise. Think like a cinematographer describing a shot list. Keep within 200 words. For best results, build your prompts using this structure:
291	
292	* Start with main action in a single sentence
293	* Add specific details about movements and gestures
294	* Describe character/object appearances precisely
295	* Include background and environment details
296	* Specify camera angles and movements
297	* Describe lighting and colors
298	* Note any changes or sudden events
299	* See [examples](#introduction) for more inspiration.
300	
301	### Automatic Prompt Enhancement
302	
303	When using `LTXVideoPipeline` directly, you can enable prompt enhancement by setting `enhance_prompt=True`.
304	
305	## 🎮 Parameter Guide
306	
307	* Resolution Preset: Higher resolutions for detailed scenes, lower for faster generation and simpler scenes. The model works on resolutions that are divisible by 32 and number of frames that are divisible by 8 + 1 (e.g. 257). In case the resolution or number of frames are not divisible by 32 or 8 + 1, the input will be padded with -1 and then cropped to the desired resolution and number of frames. The model works best on resolutions under 720 x 1280 and number of frames below 257
308	* Seed: Save seed values to recreate specific styles or compositions you like
309	* Guidance Scale: 3-3.5 are the recommended values
310	* Inference Steps: More steps (40+) for quality, fewer steps (20-30) for speed
311	
312	📝 For advanced parameters usage, please see `python inference.py --help`
313	
314	## Community Contribution
315	
316	### ComfyUI-LTXTricks 🛠️
317	
318	A community project providing additional nodes for enhanced control over the LTX Video model. It includes implementations of advanced techniques like RF-Inversion, RF-Edit, FlowEdit, and more. These nodes enable workflows such as Image and Video to Video (I+V2V), enhanced sampling via Spatiotemporal Skip Guidance (STG), and interpolation with precise frame settings.
319	
320	- **Repository:** [ComfyUI-LTXTricks](https://github.com/logtd/ComfyUI-LTXTricks)
321	- **Features:**
322	  - 🔄 **RF-Inversion:** Implements [RF-Inversion](https://rf-inversion.github.io/) with an [example workflow here](https://github.com/logtd/ComfyUI-LTXTricks/blob/main/example_workflows/example_ltx_inversion.json).
323	  - ✂️ **RF-Edit:** Implements [RF-Solver-Edit](https://github.com/wangjiangshan0725/RF-Solver-Edit) with an [example workflow here](https://github.com/logtd/ComfyUI-LTXTricks/blob/main/example_workflows/example_ltx_rf_edit.json).
324	  - 🌊 **FlowEdit:** Implements [FlowEdit](https://github.com/fallenshock/FlowEdit) with an [example workflow here](https://github.com/logtd/ComfyUI-LTXTricks/blob/main/example_workflows/example_ltx_flow_edit.json).
325	  - 🎥 **I+V2V:** Enables Video to Video with a reference image. [Example workflow](https://github.com/logtd/ComfyUI-LTXTricks/blob/main/example_workflows/example_ltx_iv2v.json).
326	  - ✨ **Enhance:** Partial implementation of [STGuidance](https://junhahyung.github.io/STGuidance/). [Example workflow](https://github.com/logtd/ComfyUI-LTXTricks/blob/main/example_workflows/example_ltxv_stg.json).
327	  - 🖼️ **Interpolation and Frame Setting:** Nodes for precise control of latents per frame. [Example workflow](https://github.com/logtd/ComfyUI-LTXTricks/blob/main/example_workflows/example_ltx_interpolation.json).
328	
329	
330	### LTX-VideoQ8 🎱 <a id="ltx-videoq8"></a>
331	
332	**LTX-VideoQ8** is an 8-bit optimized version of [LTX-Video](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-Video), designed for faster performance on NVIDIA ADA GPUs.
333	
334	- **Repository:** [LTX-VideoQ8](https://github.com/KONAKONA666/LTX-Video)
335	- **Features:**
336	  - 🚀 Up to 3X speed-up with no accuracy loss
337	  - 🎥 Generate 720x480x121 videos in under a minute on RTX 4060 (8GB VRAM)
338	  - 🛠️ Fine-tune 2B transformer models with precalculated latents
339	- **Community Discussion:** [Reddit Thread](https://www.reddit.com/r/StableDiffusion/comments/1h79ks2/fast_ltx_video_on_rtx_4060_and_other_ada_gpus/)
340	- **Diffusers integration:** A diffusers integration for the 8-bit model is already out! [Details here](https://github.com/sayakpaul/q8-ltx-video)
341	
342	
343	### TeaCache for LTX-Video 🍵 <a id="TeaCache"></a>
344	
345	**TeaCache** is a training-free caching approach that leverages timestep differences across model outputs to accelerate LTX-Video inference by up to 2x without significant visual quality degradation.
346	
347	- **Repository:** [TeaCache4LTX-Video](https://github.com/ali-vilab/TeaCache/tree/main/TeaCache4LTX-Video)
348	- **Features:**
349	  - 🚀 Speeds up LTX-Video inference.
350	  - 📊 Adjustable trade-offs between speed (up to 2x) and visual quality using configurable parameters.
351	  - 🛠️ No retraining required: Works directly with existing models.
352	
353	### Your Contribution
354	
355	...is welcome! If you have a project or tool that integrates with LTX-Video,
356	please let us know by opening an issue or pull request.
357	
358	# Training
359	
360	We provide an open-source repository for fine-tuning the LTX-Video model: [LTX-Video-Trainer](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-Video-Trainer).
361	This repository supports both the 2B and 13B model variants, enabling full fine-tuning as well as LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) fine-tuning for more efficient training. This includes:
362	
363	- **Control LoRAs**: Train custom control models like depth, pose, and canny control
364	- **Effect LoRAs**: Create specialized effects and transformations for video generation
365	
366	Explore the repository to customize the model for your specific use cases!
367	More information and training instructions can be found in the [README](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-Video-Trainer/blob/main/README.md).
368	
369	# Control Models
370	
371	[ComfyUI-LTXVideo](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo) repository now contains workflows and models for 3 specialized models that enable precise control over LTX-Video generation:
372	
373	Pose Control, Depth Control and Canny Control
374	
375	**Example ComfyUI Workflow (for all control types):** [ic-lora.json](https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/blob/master/example_workflows/ic_lora/ic-lora.json)

61	### Available Pipelines
62	
63	* **[TI2VidTwoStagesPipeline](packages/ltx-pipelines/src/ltx_pipelines/ti2vid_two_stages.py)** - Production-quality text/image-to-video with 2x upsampling (recommended)
64	* **[TI2VidTwoStagesHQPipeline](packages/ltx-pipelines/src/ltx_pipelines/ti2vid_two_stages_hq.py)** - Same two-stage flow as above but uses the res_2s second-order sampler (fewer steps, better quality)
65	* **[TI2VidOneStagePipeline](packages/ltx-pipelines/src/ltx_pipelines/ti2vid_one_stage.py)** - Single-stage generation for quick prototyping
66	* **[DistilledPipeline](packages/ltx-pipelines/src/ltx_pipelines/distilled.py)** - Fastest inference with 8 predefined sigmas
67	* **[ICLoraPipeline](packages/ltx-pipelines/src/ltx_pipelines/ic_lora.py)** - Video-to-video and image-to-video transformations (uses distilled model.)
68	* **[KeyframeInterpolationPipeline](packages/ltx-pipelines/src/ltx_pipelines/keyframe_interpolation.py)** - Interpolate between keyframe images
69	* **[A2VidPipelineTwoStage](packages/ltx-pipelines/src/ltx_pipelines/a2vid_two_stage.py)** - Audio-to-video generation conditioned on an input audio file
70	* **[RetakePipeline](packages/ltx-pipelines/src/ltx_pipelines/retake.py)** - Regenerate a specific time region of an existing video
71	
72	### ⚡ Optimization Tips
73	
74	* **Use DistilledPipeline** - Fastest inference with only 8 predefined sigmas (8 steps stage 1, 4 steps stage 2)
75	* **Enable FP8 quantization** - Enables lower memory footprint: `--quantization fp8-cast` (CLI) or `quantization=QuantizationPolicy.fp8_cast()` (Python). Fp8-cast should be used with bf16 checkpoints, it shall downcast them on the fly. For Hopper GPUs with TensorRT-LLM, use `--quantization fp8-scaled-mm` for FP8 scaled matrix multiplication. Fp8-scaled-mm should be used with fp8 checkpoints.
76	* **Install attention optimizations** - Use xFormers (`uv sync --extra xformers`) or [Flash Attention 3](https://github.com/Dao-AILab/flash-attention) for Hopper GPUs
77	* **Use gradient estimation** - Reduce inference steps from 40 to 20-30 while maintaining quality (see [pipeline documentation](packages/ltx-pipelines/README.md#denoising-loop-optimization))
78	* **Skip memory cleanup** - If you have sufficient VRAM, disable automatic memory cleanup between stages for faster processing
79	* **Choose single-stage pipeline** - Use `TI2VidOneStagePipeline` for faster generation when high resolution isn't required
80	
81	## ✍️ Prompting for LTX-2
82	
83	When writing prompts, focus on detailed, chronological descriptions of actions and scenes. Include specific movements, appearances, camera angles, and environmental details - all in a single flowing paragraph. Start directly with the action, and keep descriptions literal and precise. Think like a cinematographer describing a shot list. Keep within 200 words. For best results, build your prompts using this structure:
84	
85	- Start with main action in a single sentence
86	- Add specific details about movements and gestures
87	- Describe character/object appearances precisely
88	- Include background and environment details
89	- Specify camera angles and movements
90	- Describe lighting and colors
91	- Note any changes or sudden events
92	
93	For additional guidance on writing a prompt please refer to <https://ltx.video/blog/how-to-prompt-for-ltx-2>
94	
95	### Automatic Prompt Enhancement
96	
97	LTX-2 pipelines support automatic prompt enhancement via an `enhance_prompt` parameter.
98

100	
101	To use our model with ComfyUI, please follow the instructions at <https://github.com/Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo/>.

103	## 📦 Packages
104	
105	This repository is organized as a monorepo with three main packages:
106	
107	* **[ltx-core](packages/ltx-core/)** - Core model implementation, inference stack, and utilities
108	* **[ltx-pipelines](packages/ltx-pipelines/)** - High-level pipeline implementations for text-to-video, image-to-video, and other generation modes
109	* **[ltx-trainer](packages/ltx-trainer/)** - Training and fine-tuning tools for LoRA, full fine-tuning, and IC-LoRA
110	
111	Each package has its own README and documentation. See the [Documentation](#-documentation) section below.
112	
113	## 📚 Documentation
114

116	
117	* **[LTX-Core README](packages/ltx-core/README.md)** - Core model implementation, inference stack, and utilities
118	* **[LTX-Pipelines README](packages/ltx-pipelines/README.md)** - High-level pipeline implementations and usage guides
119	* **[LTX-Trainer README](packages/ltx-trainer/README.md)** - Training and fine-tuning documentation with detailed guides

445	    if not factors:
